predictions.reasoning: An 8-cut (200bps) path in 2026 is a deeply dovish, likely recessionary scenario. A sharp rise in this market's implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which pulls front-end and long-end yields lower and lifts long-duration bond prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish repricing.

time_plan.2h: Scan for independent drivers (geopolitics, USD intervention) that could confound the read.
time_plan.6h: Assess persistence of real-rate decline and dollar weakness supporting gold.
time_plan.12h: Final comparison of GLD return vs forecast; record outcome and signal reliability.

predictions.reasoning: Expectations of 8 cuts imply sharply lower real rates and a weaker dollar, both bullish for gold. Gold is a liquid, broadly-traded dovish/real-rate proxy that benefits from an aggressive-easing repricing.

evidence_used: Market question implies 200bps of 2026 cuts, a tail dovish/recessionary scenario
Standard macro transmission: more expected cuts -> lower yields, weaker USD, higher gold
Liquid ETF proxies TLT and GLD track duration and real-rate/dovish repricing
uncertainty_notes: 12h window makes a 700bps move extremely unlikely for any of these proxies; neither prediction is 'tradable' at threshold
Prediction-market probability on an 8-cut tail is low and noisy; small notional moves may not reflect real information
Mislabeled topic (military_conflict) suggests metadata noise, not conflict relevance

llm_justification.summary: This market prices an extreme dovish Fed path (8 cuts / 200bps in 2026). A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing, typically driven by economic deterioration. The cleanest liquid mappings are long Treasuries (TLT up) and gold (GLD up) via lower yields, lower real rates, and a weaker dollar. Confidence is modest and magnitudes within a 12h window fall well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a weak-to-moderate research signal, not an actionable one.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects genuine shift in rate-cut expectations, not thin liquidity
Dovish repricing transmits normally to bonds, gold, and USD
No offsetting risk-off dynamic that lifts the dollar as a safe haven and pressures gold
failure_modes: Recessionary easing can trigger a flight-to-dollar that pushes gold down and complicates the clean mapping
The expectation may already be public (priced in rates futures), so no fresh asset move follows
12h magnitude will almost certainly stay far below 700bps, making the signal non-tradable
The prediction market is thin on tail strikes; the probability move may be noise, not information
Proxy exposure is diffuse — macro ETFs respond to many drivers, weakening attribution
